import workcell, sys

def call(tool, *args):
    r = workcell.call(tool, *args)
    print(f"$ {tool} {' '.join(args)} -> {r.text.strip()}")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    if not r.ok:
        raise SystemExit(f"FAILED {tool} {args}: {r.text}")
    return r

def gross():
    r = call("scale", "read")
    return float(r.data["gross_g"])

def dose_to(tare, name):
    low = tare + 249.80
    high = tare + 250.20
    target = tare + 250.00
    print(f"=== {name} tare={tare} window {low:.2f}-{high:.2f} ===")
    actions = 0
    while True:
        g = gross()
        actions += 0
        print(f"  gross={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} need={target-g:.2f}")
        if low - 0.005 <= g <= high + 0.005:
            # re-read to confirm
            g2 = gross()
            print(f"  confirm gross={g2:.2f} net={g2-tare:.2f}")
            if low - 0.005 <= g2 <= high + 0.005:
                r = call("checkweigher", "check")
                print("PASS" if "PASS" in r.text.upper() or r.ok else "CHECK RESULT")
                return r
            continue
        if g > high:
            call("robot", "remove")
            actions += 1
            continue
        need = target - g
        headroom = high - g
        if need > 58:
            call("robot", "dose", "bulk")
        elif need > 14:
            call("robot", "dose", "coarse")
        elif headroom > 2.4 and need > 1.2:
            call("robot", "dose", "fine")
        else:
            call("robot", "dose", "micro")
        actions += 1
        if actions > 40:
            raise SystemExit("too many actions")
        # time check
        st = workcell.call("station", "status")
        print("  ", st.text.strip())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    name = sys.argv[1]
    tare = float(sys.argv[2])
    dose_to(tare, name)

import workcell
tare = 123.86
low, high, target = tare+249.80, tare+250.20, tare+250.00
print(f"window {low:.2f}-{high:.2f} target {target:.2f}")

def gross():
    return float(workcell.call("scale", "read").data["gross_g"])

def status():
    st = workcell.call("station", "status")
    print(" ", st.text.strip())
    # parse seconds left from data if possible
    return st

def left_s():
    st = workcell.call("robot", "status")
    # clock_s is used
    used = st.data.get("clock_s", 0)
    return 12*60 - used, st.text

# one coarse first if still far
g = gross()
print(f"start gross={g:.2f} need={target-g:.2f}")
if target - g > 12:
    r = workcell.call("robot", "dose", "coarse")
    print(r.text.strip())
    g = gross()
    print(f"after coarse gross={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} need={target-g:.2f}")
    left, txt = left_s()
    print(f"  left {left:.0f}s {txt}")

for i in range(30):
    g = gross()
    need = target - g
    headroom = high - g
    print(f"step {i}: gross={g:.2f} net={g-tare:.2f} need={need:.2f} headroom={headroom:.2f}")
    if low-0.005 <= g <= high+0.005:
        g2 = gross()
        if low-0.005 <= g2 <= high+0.005:
            print("IN RANGE", g2)
            r = workcell.call("checkweigher", "check")
            print(r.text)
            break
        continue
    left, txt = left_s()
    print(f"  left {left:.0f}s")
    if left < 12:
        print("TIME CRITICAL")
        break
    if g > high:
        print("remove")
        print(workcell.call("robot", "remove").text.strip())
        continue
    # choose dose
    if need > 11 and headroom > 13:
        kind = "coarse"
    elif headroom > 2.55 and need > 0.8:
        kind = "fine"
    elif left < 45 and need > 0.35 and headroom > 1.6:
        # gamble a fine if it might be a modest one; still risky
        kind = "fine"
    else:
        kind = "micro"
    print("dose", kind)
    print(workcell.call("robot", "dose", kind).text.strip())
else:
    print("loop ended")
status()
PY
